full_judgment: 2. Material facts of the case, briefly, are that the plaintiff petitioner became owner and possessor of the sun land by inheritance and purchase and new khatian being Khatian No.96 and 77 started in the name of plaintiff-petitioner. The plaintiff-petitioner earlier filed partition suit being Partition Suit No.17 of 1997 before the learned joint District Judge, Noakhali and the said suit was decreed in preliminary form giving saham to the plaintiff-petitioner and the defendant opposite parties. Aggrieved thereby the present plaintiff-petitioner preferred Civil Appeal No.95 of 2010 before the teamed District Judge, Noakhali which is now pending in the Court of Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Noakhali for hearing.
